meta.description: Control panel core for Go applications: an orderly start and stop of the pieces an application is made of (Unit, Panel) and a log mechanism that keeps each output apart and serves it by position: the hub (QHub) and its contracts (Chunk, Writer, Provider, Feed, Source, Controller). Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/quevu or any of the quevu-* modules, or when a Go application needs a graceful shutdown coordinated across several pieces.
